item.title: Chartists & Radical Republicans, 1840‑1865: Franchise, Socialism, and the Limits of Alliance
item.description: Chartism and Radical Republicanism compared: franchise politics, land reform, religion, and the contested boundary between democratic reform and “socialism” in the mid-19th-century Atlantic world.
